object_context: Fresh strict child of C025. Re-represent unrestricted Cavalar-Oliveira cover preservation as an exact least-closure problem on arbitrary subsets of U, rather than canonical/original-generator signatures: selected fusion pairs act as binary meet rules, semi-filter upward closure supplies monotone superset rules, and a target witness survives exactly when a non-trivial preserving closure remains. The research goal is to determine whether this higher-order noncanonical closure state exposes a fusion-bounded coordinate that can escape C009/C025 canonical compression while surviving C010 multiplexing and C021 cheap-target ceilings.
structural_coordinates: Cavalar-Oliveira semi-filters are non-empty upward-closed families of subsets of U that exclude the empty set
being above a target element a forces every generator trace B intersect U with a in B into the semi-filter
preserving a selected pair (E,H) is the conditional closure rule E,H in F implies E intersect H in F
the natural exact state candidate is the least family containing the above-witness seeds and U and closed under supersets plus the selected intersection rules
unlike C025 joint signatures, this state can contain arbitrary noncanonical subsets produced recursively by several fusion rules
cover complexity minimizes the number of selected pair rules that destroy every surviving semi-filter above every target witness
the source Fusion Problem Pi_R is itself a monotone binary-rule fixed-point computation and is realized by a cyclic monotone circuit with one AND gate per rule
the full powerset closure is exponentially large and therefore a representation, not yet a lower-bound invariant
shared rules can service many witnesses and derivations, so derivation size, depth or information cannot be assumed additive; C010 multiplexing is an immediate hostile control
any eventual explicit hard target remains subject to the C021 adjacency-circuit upper ceiling even if the closure representation is exact
equivalent_formulations: implicit Horn-style system with propositions X_S for S subseteq U, unary implications X_S -> X_T for S subseteq T, and one binary implication X_E and X_H -> X_(E intersect H) for each selected fusion pair
least fixed-point closure of target-witness generator traces under upward closure and the selected binary meet rules, with X_empty as the forbidden state
directed hypergraph reachability where unary superset arcs and binary fusion hyperedges propagate membership until either the empty set is reached or a non-trivial fixed point survives
proof/pebbling view in which each derived subset has a derivation DAG from generator traces and selected fusion rules, while the same rule may be reused across many target witnesses
search for a quotient statistic of the exact closure system whose increase or destruction per legal fusion is bounded but whose target value can exceed logarithmic scale
solved_analogues: Cavalar-Oliveira 2025 Fusion Problem Pi_R: a finite set of binary rules (a,b,c) is evaluated by monotone fixed-point propagation and can be implemented by a cyclic monotone Boolean circuit with one fan-in-two AND gate per rule
Dowling-Gallier 1984 propositional Horn satisfiability: explicit Horn implications admit forward/data-flow style propagation to a fixed point in linear time in the explicit formula size
near_solved_analogues: Jain-Klauck 2010 partition bound: global consistency LPs can be strictly stronger than simpler local rectangle/corruption or discrepancy-style bounds in randomized communication complexity, but this is a different model

Chlamtac-Friggstad-Georgiou 2012 set-cover lift-and-project analysis: generic consistency hierarchies can retain logarithmic gaps, warning that higher-order variables alone do not guarantee route progress

method_transfers.source_context: Cavalar-Oliveira 2025 Fusion Problem Pi_R and cyclic discrete complexity
method_transfers.method: Encode a family of binary fusion rules as a monotone fixed-point propagation system; treat the recursively generated state, rather than first-order labels on original generators, as the object to calibrate.
shared_structure: both systems use a finite set of binary rules whose consequences accumulate monotonically
a rule can be reused after its output is produced and can participate in later rules
cyclic/fixed-point semantics are load-bearing rather than an acyclic one-shot sequence
required_assumptions: each selected cover pair (E,H) is represented only by the legal consequence E intersect H
upward closure and above-witness generator obligations are included explicitly in the closure semantics
the closure is evaluated on finite U so the least fixed point exists
disanalogies: Pi_R has an arbitrary finite rule alphabet whereas cover preservation has an exponentially large subset universe with implicit upward rules
cover complexity quantifies over every target witness and minimizes the selected pair set, rather than evaluating one fixed rule system
an exact fixed-point representation by itself gives no super-logarithmic lower bound
method_transfers.repair_question: Can the least preserving closure be frozen as an exact calibration interface, and which quotient of its noncanonical derivation structure survives global rule reuse with a bounded per-fusion budget?
source_anchors: Cavalar-Oliveira, Boolean Circuit Complexity and Two-Dimensional Cover Problems, arXiv:2503.14117, Section 2.5 Fusion Problem Pi_R and Section 3.1 Definitions 18-21

method_transfers.source_context: propositional Horn implication systems and forward chaining
method_transfers.method: Treat target-witness generator traces as initial facts and repeatedly fire monotone implications until a least fixed point is reached; interpret derivation of a forbidden fact as failure of a preserving model.
shared_structure: binary antecedent rules fire when both prerequisites are present
least-model/fixed-point semantics separate semantic existence from a concrete derivation
required_assumptions: the subset propositions and implications exactly encode the semi-filter definition rather than a relaxation
non-emptiness is handled explicitly, for example by including U in the seed family
no algorithmic complexity claim is inferred from an exponentially large implicit Horn vocabulary
disanalogies: standard Horn-SAT input lists its variables and clauses explicitly, while the cover system contains one potential proposition per subset of U and implicit upward implications
the optimization target is the minimum selected fusion-rule family, not satisfiability of one given Horn formula
the 1984 algorithmic complexity bound does not transfer to the implicit exponential representation
method_transfers.repair_question: Does an exact least-closure equivalence hold with the intended seed/non-emptiness convention, and can small-instance calibrations expose derivation features that are not already canonical signatures?
source_anchors: Dowling and Gallier, Linear-time algorithms for testing the satisfiability of propositional Horn formulae, Journal of Logic Programming 1(3), 1984, DOI 10.1016/0743-1066(84)90014-1

method_transfers.source_context: global-consistency lower-bound relaxations in communication complexity and set cover
method_transfers.method: Use stronger joint consistency only as a discriminator for what information was missing from a local relaxation, then immediately test whether the strengthened state still admits logarithmic compression or generic integrality gaps.
shared_structure: C024 showed a sound local LP can lose root-critical simultaneous consistency
C025 restored one joint coordinate but collapsed to a previously logarithmic representation class
higher-order consistency is useful only if it targets a witnessed structural residual
required_assumptions: every imported consistency coordinate has a precise semi-filter/closure meaning
a target-domain bounded fusion law is proved separately
disanalogies: partition bounds concern randomized communication complexity and do not imply deterministic graph-cover lower bounds
generic lift-and-project hierarchy rank does not encode the bespoke semi-filter closure law automatically
method_transfers.repair_question: Which closure-derived coordinate is specific to recursive noncanonical semi-filter generation rather than merely another generic set-cover hierarchy level?
source_anchors: Jain and Klauck, The Partition Bound for Classical Communication Complexity and Query Complexity, arXiv:0910.4266
Chlamtac, Friggstad, and Georgiou, Understanding Set Cover: Sub-exponential Time Approximations and Lift-and-Project Methods, arXiv:1204.5489

explicit_disanalogies: an exact Horn/closure re-representation is not itself a new lower bound or a novelty claim
recursive noncanonical closure is strictly richer than original-generator signatures but may still be globally multiplexable
derivation depth, number of derived subsets, closure width and entropy are not automatically fusion-bounded
Horn-SAT tractability for explicit formulas says nothing about the optimization hardness of an exponentially implicit subset system
generic proof-complexity, pebbling, communication or hierarchy lower bounds require a separate target-specific bridge
random graphs demonstrate large full-cover values non-explicitly, but do not supply the explicit family needed for circuit consequences
cross-Millennium representation failures are warnings only; no theorem from another problem is imported

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A build system starts with available artifacts and repeatedly applies shared dependency rules; a downstream artifact can be produced only when all prerequisites of a rule are present, and the same rule/output may be reused by many later targets.
common_abstraction: global sharing can defeat naive additive accounting
source_to_target_mapping: available artifact -> subset already present in the preserving closure
binary build rule -> selected fusion pair (E,H) producing E intersect H
forbidden failed build state -> derivation of the empty set
shared compiled artifact -> C010-style rule/output multiplexing across many obligations
shared_constraints: once derived, an object can be reused without paying its production logic again inside the closure state
the order of rule firing should not change the least fixed point
disanalogies: real build systems do not have the semi-filter upward-closure axiom
cover complexity minimizes selected fusion rules across adversarial target witnesses rather than scheduling a fixed dependency graph
the analogy does not justify any quantitative lower bound
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Model the exact noncanonical closure first, then charge only structural features that cannot be globally reused or multiplexed across many witness derivations.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: After the strict gate passes, prove or refute the exact least-closure/semi-filter equivalence on finite instances and run C008/G_NEQ/C010 hostile calibrations showing whether recursive derived subsets add information beyond C025 while still exposing shared-rule multiplexing.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal-only structural analogy; it creates no graph-cover or P-versus-NP authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned source-internal cyclic fusion, Horn/data-flow closure, global-consistency communication bounds, lift-and-project set cover, and everyday dependency propagation. Retained the closure/dependency bridge because it maps to exact source rules and has immediate C010/C025 falsifiers.
